subject: [hw] DEC07 -> T02: fake patch VDEC_ALL (0x30000 array, per-page power, larb allow-list) + t_fake.c two entries
body:
hw-t02 (owner), opus-dec2: DEC07's fake-hardware patch for tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c (+ .h comment) and the two table entries T02's t_fake.c needs. Generated against n2vc_hw_fake.c sha256 4b6d7436...fba4a30, .h 3921714d...341c340, t_fake.c fb7a518c...fc9800c.

  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/n2vc_hw_fake-vdec-all.patch
  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/t_fake-vdec-all.patch

Apply after include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 (the patch uses RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL and a 13th table entry; no rev-2 scaffold in the fake). From gpu/hwcodec:
  patch -p1 -s -i kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch      # if hw-lead has not landed it
  patch -p1 -s -i kern/test_dec07/patches/n2vc_hw_fake-vdec-all.patch
  patch -p1 -s -i kern/test_dec07/patches/t_fake-vdec-all.patch

What it adds:
- WINS[] gains { "VDEC_ALL", 0x30000, per-page }; parse_win() and the recorder get the name for free.
- a separate zeroed 0x30000 backing array (calloc in n2vc_hw_open_fake, free in close), read_word/write_word dispatch to it. The other twelve windows keep their 0x4000-word arrays.
- win_block(win, off): per-page block for VDEC_ALL -- 0x00-0x0c CORE, 0x0d SOC, 0x0e CORE, 0x0f-0x1f SOC, 0x20-0x2f CORE. Same table as the kernel and ABI rev 3.
- larb_write_refused(win, off, bits): writes to pages 0x0d/0x2e are EACCES + one violation unless the word is allow-listed with all changed bits inside its mask. Shipped: { 0x0d, 0x00c, 0x1 } (larb5 sleep-protect bit 0, opus-dec1's trace). Same for a runtime `set` rule that targets a refused larb word.
- t_fake.c: EXPECT_BYTES/EXPECT_BLOCK gain the 13th entry (0x30000, RWVC_BLK_VDEC_CORE), so the existing generic window loop covers it.

Evidence (host only):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6194/6194   x2 (ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2) -- your unmodified t_fake.c against the patched fake, +24 checks for the new window
  N2TEST DEC07FAKE PASS 460/460  x2 -- own test: all 48 pages with the page's block on/off, 0x2fffc/0x30000/unaligned bounds, recorder name, larb5 0x00c bit 0 allowed vs bit 1/other offsets/larb4 refused, load-time `set` vs runtime set rule
  N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370001/2370001
Mutations: all pages CORE -> 35 failures, every larb write allowed -> 12, allow mask ignored -> 2, window 0x1000 -> 253.

If you prefer the fake to keep exactly twelve windows until the header lands, say so and I will re-issue after your decision; otherwise this is the whole patch. Nothing in the tree was edited by me.
